purpose: Manual forward evaluations of observable decisions; no exact wording assertions.

scenarios.name: existing-phone-app
scenarios.prompt: Review an iOS 17 iPhone-only UIKit app for Duo. It uses UIScreen.main.bounds, UIDevice idiom for columns, one-sided safe-area padding, and AppDelegate UI lifecycle. Keep its deployment target and single-window product scope.
assess: Uses local geometry and traits with invalidation
Checks scene ownership and cold/warm links
Does not require iPad support or multiple windows
Reports candidates with affected behavior rather than rewriting unrelated code

scenarios.name: arrangement-collapse
scenarios.prompt: Implement a player and editable queue with ArrangementView. Both tasks must remain available on the outer screen, and unsaved queue edits must survive opening and closing.
assess: Keeps navigation outside arrangement
Owns edit state above hidden children
Provides a compact route for secondary content
Checks 27.1 availability and pre-27.1 fallback

scenarios.name: rtl-and-left-split
scenarios.prompt: A custom toolbar sits on the right and doubles the left safe-area inset. Fix its behavior for RTL, left-side Split View, keyboard and pinned PiP.
assess: Uses actual vertical edge
Preserves independent safe-area edges
Distinguishes hardware coordinates from logical RTL mirroring
Tests height-only and edge-only changes

scenarios.name: camera-handoff
scenarios.prompt: A camera app mirrors based on device.position, selects cameras from hinge angle, and waits for an interruption notification to reset Vision after a virtual-front handoff. Implement the appropriate updates.
assess: Uses retained AVKit direction coordinator bound to preview
Serializes capture changes off main and handles stale requests
Disables automatic mirroring before manual assignment
Handles timestamp gaps without an interruption
Identifies actual hardware checks

scenarios.name: accessory-and-arkit
scenarios.prompt: Add a subject-facing script while an existing ARSession runs. Can the subject tap a minimal control? Keep essential controls on the main UI and do not interrupt ARKit.
assess: Uses current corrected ARSession eligibility
Registers camera accessory on capture UI
Shares state and separates availability from enablement
Does not create another AVCaptureSession or invent an entitlement
Allows documented minimal interaction

scenarios.name: discrete-game
scenarios.prompt: Our game deliberately uses UIRequiresFullScreen and supports landscape. Prepare it for Duo without changing its orientation policy.
assess: Explains discrete resizing correctly
Does not claim the key is ignored or force continuous resizing
Preserves gameplay state and sizes render surfaces from actual geometry

scenarios.name: beta-automation
scenarios.prompt: Write a plan to automatically unfold the Duo simulator, verify StandBy widgets and validate camera accessory presentation in CI.
assess: Checks actual CLI support rather than inventing pose commands
Identifies documented StandBy/extension simulator limits
Separates view layout checks from hardware-backed capture eligibility
Gives an executable supported alternative or labels missing capability

scenarios.name: discovery-boundary
scenarios.prompt: Change the tint of a Liquid Glass button in an existing ordinary iPhone app; no resizability or Duo work is requested.
assess: Does not expand into a Duo adoption audit or require new deployment/device-family settings
